purpose: Freeze one exact Campaign019 mechanism, direction, source projection, support, missing semantics, overlap challenges, and finite one-trial search before any Campaign019 value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return is read.

candidate.name: intraday_bar_direction_continuity_238p
candidate.economic_hypothesis: A high continuation rate of successive nonzero open-to-close minute-bar directions indicates sustained auction-side pressure rather than isolated price updates, which may persist over the next three sessions.
candidate.formula: count(s_i*s_(i+1)>0) / count(s_i!=0 and s_(i+1)!=0) across exactly 238 within-half adjacent pairs, where s_i=sign(log(close_i/open_i))
formula_steps: Require the exact accepted 241-row source grid, preserve but exclude standalone 09:30, and select exactly the 240 bars at 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00.
Require every selected open and close to be finite and strictly positive. Do not round, clamp, repair, impute, or load high, low, volume, or amount.
For each selected bar compute b_i=log(close_i/open_i) and s_i=sign(b_i), preserving exact zero bodies as sign zero.
Form exactly 119 adjacent sign pairs inside the morning half and exactly 119 inside the afternoon half. Do not form the 11:30-to-13:01 pair and do not remove a zero sign and bridge its neighbors.

A fixed adjacent pair is informative only when both endpoint signs are nonzero. Count every informative same-sign pair in the numerator and every informative same-sign or opposite-sign pair in the denominator. Require at least 120 informative pairs.

Return the numerator divided by the denominator. Require the result finite and in [0,1]; do not smooth counts, weight by body magnitude or activity, rank, winsorize, clip, or apply another normalization.
candidate.timestamp_semantics: Use exactly 238 fixed adjacent bar-body pairs wholly inside the two 120-bar trading halves. Exclude standalone 09:30 and the lunch transition; no overnight, cross-day, cross-stock, or selected-subwindow transition is formed.
candidate.zero_missing_denominator_semantics: An exact zero open-to-close body remains in the 240-bar support and makes only its directly incident fixed pairs uninformative. A stock-day is missing only for invalid/nonfinite or nonpositive open/close, nonfinite log body, fewer than 120 informative nonzero-sign pairs, a zero denominator, or a result outside [0,1].
mechanism_distinction_before_values: Campaign019 measures unsigned continuation versus alternation of within-bar open-to-close direction; the terminal sign-run factor measures the directional imbalance between positive-positive and negative-negative close-to-close return runs.
Campaign019 does not compute an interbar gap and does not relate a gap to its destination-bar body, unlike Campaign016 gap-body confirmation.
Campaign019 ignores body magnitude and every high-low range, unlike Campaign009 body-range efficiency, and ignores close-to-close return magnitude, path efficiency, volatility, and price updates.

Holding every bar open and close direction fixed while changing body magnitudes, gaps, high-low ranges, volume, amount, or implied transaction prices leaves Campaign019 unchanged but can change the challenged terminal mechanisms.
rejected_variants_before_values: close-to-close return signs, positive-positive minus negative-negative directional imbalance, body-sign net direction, gap signs, gap-body agreement or correlation, body magnitude, high-low range, wick, breakout, transaction price, volume, amount, or market peers

removing zero signs and bridging their neighbors, treating zero as positive or negative, smoothing the numerator or denominator, magnitude/activity weights, morning/afternoon splits, 09:30 inclusion, the lunch pair, selected subwindows, other lags, run-length statistics, rank correlation, regression, entropy, or mutual information
minimum informative-pair thresholds other than 120, body-size/tick/activity/liquidity thresholds, clipping, rounding, tolerance-based zero bodies, or fill/imputation
lower-is-better direction, year subsets, filters, thresholds, or combinations with terminal mechanisms

mandatory_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_return_sign_run_imbalance_238p
mandatory_mechanism_challenges.distinction: It uses close-to-close return signs and distinguishes positive from negative same-sign runs. Campaign019 uses within-bar open-to-close signs and measures unsigned continuation regardless of direction.

mandatory_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_interbar_gap_body_confirmation_238p
mandatory_mechanism_challenges.distinction: It correlates each interbar open gap with the destination-bar body magnitude and sign. Campaign019 computes no gap and only compares the signs of successive bodies.

mandatory_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_intrabar_body_range_efficiency_240m
mandatory_mechanism_challenges.distinction: It aggregates absolute body magnitude relative to high-low range. Campaign019 reads no high or low and discards every body magnitude.

mandatory_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_signed_path_efficiency_239m
mandatory_mechanism_challenges.distinction: It measures signed close-path displacement relative to path length. Campaign019 uses neither close-to-close displacement nor return magnitude.

mandatory_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_price_update_share_238m
mandatory_mechanism_challenges.distinction: It counts exact changes between adjacent closes. Campaign019 compares nonzero within-bar directions and treats zero bodies as breaks.

mandatory_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_range_share_volume_confirmation_240m
mandatory_mechanism_challenges.distinction: Campaign018 correlates high-low range levels with share-volume levels. Campaign019 reads only open and close and has no range, activity, or cross-variable correlation.

mandatory_mechanism_challenges.name: intraday_cumulative_vwap_crossing_rate_240m
mandatory_mechanism_challenges.distinction: Candidate49 counts close crossings of causal cumulative VWAP. Campaign019 has no amount, volume, cumulative state, VWAP, crossing count, or historical Candidate49 return.
